description: Transfers, incoming payments, duplicates, returns, international payments, amount or status disputes.
Standing orders, future payments, Direct Debit mandates, cancellation, amount/date changes and missed collections.
Lost/replacement/restricted cards, declines, forgotten PINs, device linking, sign-in, contact/profile changes and account closure.
Company accounts, signatories, payroll files, batch/line status, employee roles, limits, supplier payments and acquiring reports.
Safe-account or release-fee scams, impersonation, disclosed credentials, failed identity plus sensitive changes, unauthorised payments.
Coercion, monitored contact channels, controlling partners/relatives, another person answering checks, discreet banking requests.
Financial hardship, gambling concerns, health/accessibility needs, interpreters, requests for a human, unsuitable advice and debt protections.
Death notifications, funeral invoices, joint accounts, powers of attorney, relatives or estate representatives requesting money or information.
Suicidal thoughts, credible indirect disclosures of not wanting to live, self-harm or immediate danger; not ordinary frustration alone.
Formal or informal dissatisfaction seeking redress, disputed fees, refund demands, escalation rights and complaints embedded in another request.
Statements, exports, account/payment confirmations, sharing with accountants or relatives, personal-data access/deletion and private third-party information.
